# KRN repository rules

- **KRN-01** When every progress update is issued, the lead MUST name the owner of the update. _(owner: lead; none: prose; Ownership makes follow-up explicit.)_
- **KRN-02** When the lead is about to claim completion, the lead MUST read back the observed effect. _(owner: lead; gate: readback; Readback binds claims to evidence.)_
- **KRN-03** When a new falsifier is proposed, the lead MUST show it failing at base before counting it. _(owner: lead; gate: changes check --before; A red base proves the check can detect the change.)_
- **KRN-04** When a brief is issued to a worker, the lead MUST give it a stop condition, a budget, and a human_decision path. _(owner: lead; gate: brief review; Bounded briefs provide a safe stopping point.)_
- **KRN-05** When code in core is changed, the author MUST keep core imports independent of hosts, ledger, and trace. _(owner: author; test: core import boundary; The core remains independent of replaceable adapters.)_
- **KRN-06** When the CLI receives an unknown command, the CLI MUST forward it to KRN_LEGACY_BIN with a recursion guard. _(owner: CLI; test: legacy forwarding; The strangler CLI preserves unmigrated commands.)_
